headline.title: A startup claims it broke through a bottleneck that’s holding back LLMs
headline.summary: Miami-based AI startup Subquadratic has emerged from stealth mode, claiming to have solved a long-standing mathematical bottleneck affecting large language models. While initial details were sparse and met with skepticism, the company is beginning to provide evidence to support its assertions.

articles.title: The US says ASML’s top chip tool may be in China. ASML says it isn’t
articles.summary: The U.S. government has raised concerns that ASML's advanced chip manufacturing equipment may be in China, while ASML has denied these claims. The company argues that it would not jeopardize its export license by supplying such technology to a Chinese customer.

articles.title: Source: Elastic agrees to buy CRV-backed DeductiveAI for up to $85M
articles.summary: Elastic has agreed to acquire DeductiveAI, a startup focused on using AI for software bug detection and resolution, for up to $85 million. Founded three years ago and backed by CRV, DeductiveAI aims to enhance software reliability through its innovative technology.

articles.title: AI inference startup Baseten reportedly raising $1.5B months after its last mega-round
articles.summary: AI inference startup Baseten is reportedly nearing the completion of a $1.5 billion funding round, which would value the company at $13 billion. This follows a significant funding round just months prior, highlighting the ongoing demand in the AI inference sector.

articles.title: Measuring Curriculum Alignment across Topical Coverage, Competency, and Cognitive Depth: A Longitudinal Framework Applied to CS2013 and CS2023
articles.summary: The article presents a framework for measuring curriculum alignment in undergraduate computer science programs, focusing on topical coverage, competency, and cognitive depth in relation to international guidelines. This approach utilizes a human-in-the-loop pipeline to assess how well programs adhere to evolving curricular standards, specifically comparing the CS2013 and CS2023 guidelines.

articles.title: AI4SE and SE4AI Exploration: A Decade Looking Back and Forward
articles.summary: The article reviews the evolution of artificial intelligence in systems engineering over the past decade, categorizing developments into foundational, applied, and large language model (LLM) phases. It highlights the growth of a research community sparked by a 2020 INCOSE INSIGHT special issue, which has since attracted over 250 participants to its annual workshop.

articles.title: BrainG3N: A Dual-Purpose Tokenizer for Controllable 3D Brain MRI Generation
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced BrainG3N, a dual-purpose tokenizer designed to enhance the generation of controllable 3D brain MRI images. This innovation aims to improve clinical applications in neurology and neuro-oncology by addressing the challenges of retaining clinical information while facilitating data sharing and simulating disease trajectories.

articles.title: TelcoAgent: A Scalable 5G Multi-KPM Forecasting With 3GPP-Grounded Explainability
articles.summary: TelcoAgent is a new framework designed for scalable and explainable forecasting of Key Performance Measurements (KPMs) in 5G and next-generation telecom networks. The model addresses the limitations of existing machine learning approaches, enhancing proactive network management capabilities.

articles.title: Rethinking Shrinkage Bias in LLM FP4 Pretraining: Geometric Origin, Systemic Impact, and UFP4 Recipe
articles.summary: The article discusses the limitations of current FP4 training methods for large language models (LLMs), specifically highlighting the Shrinkage Bias associated with non-uniform data formats like E2M1. The authors propose a new approach, termed UFP4, to mitigate these issues and improve the efficiency of LLM pretraining on existing hardware systems.

articles.title: Ensembles of Large Language Models for Identifying EQ-5D Studies in PubMed Based on Their Abstracts
articles.summary: This study explores the application of ensemble large language models, including Google's Gemini, for the automated identification of EQ-5D studies in PubMed based on their abstracts. The research aims to improve the efficiency and consistency of screening in systematic literature reviews, addressing the challenges faced by human reviewers in classifying health-related quality-of-life studies.

articles.title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
articles.summary: The DeepSeek-V4 series introduces two advanced Mixture-of-Experts language models, DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1.6 trillion parameters and DeepSeek-V4-Flash with 284 billion parameters, both capable of handling a context length of one million tokens. Key architectural upgrades include a hybrid attention mechanism and enhanced optimization techniques to improve efficiency and performance.

articles.title: StaminaBench: Stress-Testing Coding Agents over 100 Interaction Turns
articles.summary: StaminaBench is a new benchmark designed to evaluate the endurance of coding agents by measuring how many consecutive interaction turns they can manage before failure. The benchmark focuses on real-world coding scenarios, requiring agents to implement and modify a REST API server through a series of procedurally generated change requests.
